# danish: Hvad laver du i din fritid?
english: What do you do in your spare time?

# danish: Jeg læser bøger og lytter til musik.
english: I read books and listen to music.

# danish: Skal vi gå i biografen på lørdag?
english: Shall we go to the cinema on Saturday?

# danish: Filmen er på dansk med engelske undertekster.
english: The film is in Danish with English subtitles.

# danish: Jeg har lånt en roman på biblioteket.
english: I have borrowed a novel from the library.

# danish: Du kan også låne lydbøger.
english: You can also borrow audiobooks.

# danish: Vi skal til koncert i aften.
english: We are going to a concert tonight.

# danish: Hun spiller guitar i et lille band.
english: She plays guitar in a small band.

# danish: Kan du synge med på omkvædet?
english: Can you sing along with the chorus?

# danish: Jeg hører den samme sang igen for at forstå teksten.
english: I am listening to the same song again to understand the lyrics.

# danish: Min bror spiller håndbold hver onsdag.
english: My brother plays handball every Wednesday.

# danish: Jeg svømmer en gang om ugen.
english: I swim once a week.

# danish: Hvem vandt kampen i går?
english: Who won the match yesterday?

# danish: Lad os spille et brætspil efter aftensmaden.
english: Let us play a board game after dinner.

# danish: Du må forklare reglerne først.
english: You will have to explain the rules first.

# danish: Min telefon er løbet tør for strøm.
english: My phone has run out of battery.

# danish: Hvad er adgangskoden til det trådløse netværk?
english: What is the password for the wireless network?

# danish: Jeg kan ikke åbne den vedhæftede fil.
english: I cannot open the attachment.

# danish: Husk at gemme dokumentet, før du lukker programmet.
english: Remember to save the document before closing the program.

# danish: Jeg har slået notifikationer fra, så jeg kan koncentrere mig.
english: I have turned off notifications so I can concentrate.
